evidence.location: Article 3 — Dried, diluted, processed and compound food
evidence.text: Article 3 Dried, diluted, processed and compound food 1. Where no specific Union maximum levels are set out in Annex I for food which is dried, diluted, processed or compound food (i.e. composed of more than one ingredient), the following aspects shall be taken into account when applying the maximum levels set out in Annex I to such food: (a) changes of the concentration of the contaminant caused by drying or dilution processes; (b) changes of the concentration of the contaminant caused by processing; (c) the relative proportions of the ingredients in the product; (d) the analytical limit of quantification. 2. Where the competent authority carries out an official control, the food business operator shall provide and justify the specific concentration, dilution or processing factors for the drying, diluting or processing operations concerned or the specific concentration, dilution or processing factors for the dried, diluted, processed or compound food concerned as well as the proportion of ingredients for mixing operations concerned. Where the food business operator does not provide the necessary concentration, dilution or processing factor or where the competent authority deems that factor inappropriate in view of the justification given, the competent authority shall itself define that factor, based on the available information and with the objective of maximum protection of human health. 3. Where no specific Union maximum levels for food for infants and young children are set out in Annex I, Member States may provide for stricter maximum levels for such food.

evidence.text: Article 2 Entry into force and application This Regulation shall enter into force on the twentieth day following its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union . It shall apply as from 14 December 2019.

Article 17 Responsibilities 1. Food and feed business operators at all stages of production, processing and distribution within the businesses under their control shall ensure that foods or feeds satisfy the requirements of food law which are relevant to their activities and shall verify that such requirements are met. 2. Member States shall enforce food law, and monitor and verify that the relevant requirements of food law are fulfilled by food and feed business operators at all stages of production, processing and distribution. For that purpose, they shall maintain a system of official controls and other activities as appropriate to the circumstances, including public communication on food and feed safety and risk, food and feed safety surveillance and other monitoring activities covering all stages of production, processing and distribution. Member States shall also lay down the rules on measures and penalties applicable to infringements of food and feed law. The measures and penalties provided for shall be effective, proportionate and dissuasive.

final_output:
## Short answer

**Aflatoxin B1 being detected does not by itself establish non-compliance.** The supplied 2023/915 table sets a maximum of **6.0 μg/kg for aflatoxin B1** in dried figs and **10.0 μg/kg for the sum of aflatoxins B1, B2, G1 and G2**. The concentration and, for the sum limit, the other aflatoxin results are unknown, so compliance cannot be determined. [E84bba6f619]

The excerpts also describe enhanced border checks for specified Türkiye-origin dried-fig products, with a **30% frequency of identity and physical checks**, and require aflatoxin sampling and analysis to follow Regulation (EU) 2023/2782. But the supplied material does **not** establish that this regime is in force for the shipment now: the 2019/1793 table is a consolidated version dated 2026-06-30, and a consolidation date alone does not verify present legal effect. [Effd100d7a6] [E6755b594ef]

## Evidence-supported requirements

- **Maximum levels:** For dried figs, the table gives 6.0 μg/kg for B1 and 10.0 μg/kg for the sum of B1, B2, G1 and G2. The sum is assessed on a lower-bound basis, treating values below the limit of quantification as zero. The dried-fig limits also apply to products consisting only of dried figs or made up of at least 80% dried figs. [E84bba6f619]
- **Other processed or compound products:** Where no specific Union maximum is set for the product, account for changes caused by drying, dilution or processing, ingredient proportions and the analytical limit of quantification. During official control, the operator must provide and justify relevant concentration, dilution or processing factors and mixing proportions; the authority may set a factor if none is provided or the justification is inadequate. [Eb2674e6c28]
- **Border checks and sampling, if the cited regime applies:** The supplied Annex II entry covers specified Türkiye-origin dried figs and fig-containing products, lists aflatoxins and ochratoxin A, and gives a 30% frequency of identity and physical checks. It does not mean every consignment is necessarily sampled or tested. [Effd100d7a6] For covered food consignments, Article 3 points mycotoxin sampling and analysis to Regulation (EU) 2023/2782; its detailed procedures are not included in the supplied excerpts. [E6755b594ef]
- **Official-control samples and methods:** Samples must be taken, handled and labelled to preserve legal, scientific and technical validity. Official-control methods must follow applicable Union rules; the excerpt provides fallback method rules where those are absent. [E89a5746a84] [Ec28a37e9c2]
- **Operator responsibility:** Food-business operators must ensure and verify, within the businesses they control, that food meets relevant food-law requirements. [E32d56f6d3a]
- **Prior notification, conditionally:** For consignments within the categories in Article 47(1) of Regulation (EU) 2017/625, the operator must notify the first-arrival border control post at least one working day before expected arrival; a competent authority may allow at least four hours where logistical constraints prevent that deadline. The excerpts do not establish whether this particular shipment falls within those categories. [E2015741215]

## Facts and law to verify

- The measured B1 concentration; B2, G1 and G2 results; units; and whether the results come from representative, valid sampling. Without these, an exceedance cannot be determined. [E84bba6f619] [Ec28a37e9c2]
- Whether the goods are dried figs, a product consisting only of dried figs, a product with at least 80% dried figs, or another processed or compound product; for the latter, the applicable factors and ingredient proportions are needed. [E84bba6f619] [Eb2674e6c28]
- Whether the cited Türkiye entry and its 30% check frequency remain legally applicable on the shipment date, and whether the product’s exact form and CN/TARIC code fall within its scope. The supplied consolidated table does not establish current legal effect. [Effd100d7a6]
- Whether this consignment requires prior notification under the cited rule. [E2015741215]
- The detailed sampling plan, analytical method and reporting requirements under Regulation (EU) 2023/2782, and any consignment-specific certificate, laboratory-result or other documentary requirement. Those details could not be established from the supplied excerpts. [E6755b594ef]

## Practical next steps

1. Obtain the laboratory report and establish whether B1 exceeds 6.0 μg/kg; also obtain the four-aflatoxin results to assess the 10.0 μg/kg sum limit. [E84bba6f619]
2. Confirm product composition and processing stage. If the product is not covered directly by the dried-fig row, assemble and justify the processing/concentration factors and ingredient proportions for any official control. [E84bba6f619] [Eb2674e6c28]
3. Confirm the shipment’s exact product code and check the applicable border-control listing and notification requirements for the shipment date with the relevant competent authority or border control post. [Effd100d7a6] [E2015741215]
4. If official sampling or testing is required, confirm the applicable Regulation (EU) 2023/2782 procedure with the competent authority or laboratory, and retain traceable sampling, handling, labelling and analytical records. [E6755b594ef] [E89a5746a84]
